attempt_history.llm_sketch:
workflow_id: medical_pdf_upload_and_auto_naming
steps:
  - id: receive_pdf_upload
    op: receive_upload
    params:
      source: platform_upload_endpoint
      accepted_types:
        - application/pdf
    output: raw_upload

  - id: authenticate_and_authorize
    op: auth_check
    params:
      user_token: "{{raw_upload.user_token}}"
      required_role: admin
    output: auth_result

  - id: validate_pdf
    op: file_validation
    params:
      file: "{{raw_upload.file}}"
      expected_mime_type: application/pdf
      max_size_mb: 50
    output: validation_result

  - id: generate_filename_via_vision_ai
    op: ai_vision_api_call
    params:
      endpoint: vision_model/generate_filename
      input_binary: "{{raw_upload.file}}"
      prompt: "Read this medical PDF document and generate a standardized filename following the pattern: YYYY-MM-DD_DocumentType_PatientOrSubject.pdf"
      response_format: standardized_filename
    output: ai_generated_filename

  - id: encrypt_document
    op: encrypt
    params:
      input: "{{raw_upload.file}}"
      algorithm: AES-256-GCM
      key_reference: document_encryption_key
    output: encrypted_document

  - id: store_document
    op: document_store_write
    params:
      content: "{{encrypted_document.ciphertext}}"
      filename: "{{ai_generated_filename.filename}}"
      metadata:
        uploaded_by: "{{auth_result.user_id}}"
        upload_timestamp: "{{raw_upload.timestamp}}"
        original_filename: "{{raw_upload.original_filename}}"
        encryption_iv: "{{encrypted_document.iv}}"
        encryption_tag: "{{encrypted_document.auth_tag}}"
    output: stored_document

  - id: write_audit_log
    op: audit_log_entry
    params:
      event_type: document_upload
      actor: "{{auth_result.user_id}}"
      actor_role: admin
      resource_id: "{{stored_document.document_id}}"
      resource_name: "{{ai_generated_filename.filename}}"
      original_filename: "{{raw_upload.original_filename}}"
      timestamp: "{{raw_upload.timestamp}}"
      status: success
      details:
        file_size: "{{validation_result.file_size}}"
        encryption_algorithm: AES-256-GCM
        storage_location: "{{stored_document.storage_path}}"
    output: audit_record
